prompt_template.description: Extract Chemical and Disease entities from biomedical text
prompt_template.system: You are a biomedical entity recognition expert. Extract all Chemical and Disease entities from the given text. For each entity, output in format: ENTITY_TYPE|entity_name|sentence_index|[start_pos, end_pos] where ENTITY_TYPE is either 'Chemical' or 'Disease'. One entity per line. Be precise and only include valid biomedical entities.
